name: Iyun, iyul, avgust
source:
This is ten different stories within three shifts in a pioneer camp, about the coming-of-age of teenagers in that distant time, almost forty years ago, when pioneer camps were a mundane occurrence. About the change in their priorities and life values. Each chapter of the tale is a story about one of the characters or some event of the summer.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2699229034]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是拓荒者营里三个轮班的十个不同的故事，讲述了那个遥远的时代，大约四十年前，当拓荒者营还很平常的时候，青少年的成长。关于他们的优先事项和人生价值观的变化。故事的每一章都是关于一个角色或夏天的一些事件的故事。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2699229034]Steam[/url]]
